title: The Unsigned Figure

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Nine men may read one figure and none of them wrote the space where the price should stand. The pot keeps its crack, the grain keeps its cost, and the slate keeps only what was read over it.
epigraph.attribution: A market saying of Low Kiln, at the going out of Ash

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and fifty-seven to three hundred and fifty-nine days, six months and one hundred and seventy-seven to one hundred and seventy-nine days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: as in chapters 25 through 101 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it, with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and fifty-seven, fifty-eight and fifty-nine days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go. On Ash 30 the dark month's third and last reading comes to the Cross and **nine arithmetics of the year stand behind one unsigned figure — nine are nine and not one account**; the figure read is still not the figure paid, no signature stands on the space, and the finding is kept on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine standing out of nine. Nothing is opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Eighth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{357}{Ash 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary tending day with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 288 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking. No recap: nothing from Ash 25, 26 or 27 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the extra holding Jorra left in the cold iron on the twenty-sixth stands on its own place, gathered once and not made again with no payer under it; the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction stand where they were put, nowhere to be asked and buying no lesson under this roof. Carry 288 honest answers on the sixth place, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told with four, four and a gap, nine hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that and the holding of Ash 26 beside all with a finger between every pair, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the row at five askings, and eight arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked and unread up the clay road in Berr's box — eight are eight and not one account, figure read not figure paid, no signature, finding on a place of its own, no doctrine out of eight (T015/T041/T047 held). Count 356 → 357 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-six → one hundred and seventy-seven days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 357 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside; the infant's louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelling without verdict, both true, neither winning (T060/T086). Hearth grammar at both ends of the morning's opening, beat for beat: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar standing cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077, T060/T086). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079). In the small hours the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a tool put away — answer 289: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the held objects (T061/T082). Ash 28 kept without a boundary drawn; Ash 30 stands two mornings ahead, named only as a date and never as a promise.

scenes.title: The Ninth Hand at the Well
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 28 through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail, Ilva (one appearance at the yard well); Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Berr, no Hessa on any road, no runner, no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no market, Cross or bell, and no ownerless voice over the boards — the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third stand where they were put and do not repeat. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire to be banked against their coming back, never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number: clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw unswept both; space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates; the gone pan's round ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the trough's skin; the field's empty place on the worked strips; the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, gone around widest of all — seven places entered none, for a thing entered wants a payer standing and none stood (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause: the gone white frost on the well's north lip, the skin on the trough, the plate of ice (T083/T085). Dressed grain turned once under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child, no figure, no handful, fingers in and out without closing (T077). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the hare sent to the weather which carried the snow and can carry the price, the cracked jar sent to a pot that says nothing, the kindling woman asking what the seventh year will want and two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late (T077). At the well Ilva: pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam; her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays, the short notched birch strip pale where a thumb has rubbed it and dark in the uncut grain, not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any saying that arrived nowhere; eyes to the asker and mouth after both with a half-beat; to a woman asking what Ash's firings had taken she answers the question put and not the one behind it — *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* — and puts her flat hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and files it as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth and no tenth; he makes no reader of her own keeping and joins her to none, and she is expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080 advanced and not paid). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, says *Yes, house* to early and late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying; checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and finds each where put and not made again, not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not a tenth stopping, not the calling of the loan, no payer standing; brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled; his stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*) and tells a pot *You'll do*, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it; his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, and he does not leave the extra interval of the twenty-sixth a second time — the holding of Ash 26 stays where nobody would enter it, gathered once and not made again, for a second would be a habit and a third a way, both of which want a payer and none stood (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, the half-beat longer than the setting needed, the thread left frozen and unwiped; the widow's mark untouched because an afternoon and a going of the light are not openings. In the small hours the hand goes up an inch, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the river's finishing, comes straight down — answer 290, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twenty-Ninth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{358}{Ash 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary tending day with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner or collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on answer 290. Carry 290 honest answers on the sixth place; eight arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box, figure read not figure paid, no signature, finding on its own place, no doctrine out of eight; six hearings with seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; nine hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled; five held objects with pot-crack resting beside and hand-at-sill breath beside that and the holding of Ash 26 beside all, none a sixth, seventh or eighth; burned slate at five with shut-room tellings at two and row at five askings; well-saying at four shapings and Hessa's writing turned toward herself and unread; Ilva's strip unread; the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, still gathering and unspent, with no sixth telling, no third shut-room telling, no witness and no payer (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). Count 357 → 358 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-seven → one hundred and seventy-eight days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 358 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 358 days (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order and the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed with neither verdict: leathery crust two inches off with corner a hair off the wool and empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside (T060/T086). Hearth grammar at both ends of the morning's opening, beat for beat: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with the touch lighter than a woman uses on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Widow's mark untouched; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due (T058/T079). In the small hours the hand takes its small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the river's finishing and lays itself back against the fold — answer 291, a restraint and not a payment, laid across none of the held objects (T061/T082). Ash 29 kept without a boundary drawn; Ash 30 stands one morning ahead, named only as a date and never as a promise, and no ninth arithmetic is supplied early.

scenes.title: The Last Quiet Afternoon
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 29, the last fully quiet tending day of the dark month, through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no runner, no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no market, Cross or bell, and no ownerless voice on the twenty-ninth — the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third stand where they were put and do not repeat, and no sixth telling of the burned slate, third telling of the shut room, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping is made due. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire to be banked against their coming back, never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, seven places entered none (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085). Dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted, her fingers going in and coming out without closing (T077). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the hare sent to the weather, the cracked jar sent to a pot that says nothing, the seventh year and the thaw answered with *Yes, house* and the late kept because it puts off the paying (T077). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, checks the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting and finds each where put and not made again, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the returned half-check of Bone 8 on the flagstone's own place with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 beat and the Frost 5 beat — four held changes on four places and not a rule (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person and tells a pot *You'll do*, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, moving the tongue a hair's breadth and leaving it standing; he does not make a second of the extra holding of Ash 26, which stays on its own place gathered once and not spent (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, the thread left frozen and unwiped; widow's mark untouched because an afternoon and a going of the light are not openings. In the small hours the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing and lays itself back against the fold — answer 292, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Foreshadowing: the ninth arithmetic that will stand behind the figure when its morning is earned is held unnamed for one more day, and Stone comes on in the dark beyond the door and is not brought into this day.

scenes.title: The Ninth Reading
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{359}{Ash 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: the dark month's third and last Account-day and market, earned by its own morning, before first light through the reading at the Cross and the going of the light. THIS SCENE HOLDS THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid). Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Berr Clay, Hessa Rale; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the two hundred at the Cross, the soft-cuffed clerk set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the silent green-mouthed woman at the pot board, the foundling's shape at the market's edge, and the yards' morning directions. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on answer 292; count 358 → 359 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-eight → one hundred and seventy-nine days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 359 days and Garl's name unspoken the same (T088, T009/T013/T092). Sella carries him down before first light at the half-pace she keeps from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lies, stands half a pace off through the reading and says nothing to the basket; the pot rim stays two inches beyond the reaching hand and the body is inventoried in the surgeon's old order, the surgeon's knowing exact and useless against the infant's louder want (T060/T086). Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweet green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, and under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all; his hands large and clean, he wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened against his forearm with the writing inward, passes a finger over the figure through the cloth of his sleeve, reads *One in twelve, as the notice says* twice over the basket — once for the moot and once for the late households — calls the levy and denies it with *The levy is called. It is not called by me* and *your house*, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, says something low to the block about kindness being entered, and goes off up the clay road with the box locked and Ash's third true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness. **Nine arithmetics of the year — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, and Ash's first, second and third — now stand behind one unsigned figure; nine are nine and not one account**, the printed figure still one in twelve and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space between. The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not folded into the counts (T078). Hessa Rale takes the slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon with the second strap let out and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the writing turned to her sleeve and no figure coming off it — a runner and not a reader, her eighth record-first hand eight with no tenth, joined to none (T080). The soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge for a measure nobody called, slate turned inward and hand to slate before eye to stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090). The seventh green at a silent woman's mouth and the seventh shape at the market's edge stay a colour and a shape on places of their own with no eighth, unnamed, unjoined and never Fenna or Ulda; the foundling's half-turn comes after the knock and is a turn, not a hearing, and is not joined to the boy's own turning (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held). The boy files the finding on a place of its own with no payer standing: the reading is a reading and nine are nine and not one account, expressly not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction, the holding of Ash 26 or his own kept gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between. No doctrine stands up out of nine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; nothing from the reading answers the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188, the carried fire's missing fifth, the cold foot below the sill, the burned slate, the shut room or the room with the damper closed. In the small hours the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down — answer 293, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, laid across none of the held objects (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Ash Going Out
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 30 at the Clay Yard's seven places, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva this afternoon, no Berr and no Hessa on any road (the runner went up before noon), no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no second reading and no ownerless voice — the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third stand where they were put and do not repeat. Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace, going wide around the seven places with a look and no number, sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and leaves the thread frozen and unwiped, and says nothing of where they had been or what had been read over the basket. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number; three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted; hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085, T077, T098 carried). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, checks the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting and finds each where put and not made again, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person, tells a pot *You'll do*, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and does not leave the extra interval a second time — the holding of Ash 26 stands where nobody would enter it, gathered once and not spent (T062/T035/T031). The whole file comes out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out on a towel and is checked and left as it lay: **nine arithmetics of the year behind one unsigned figure — nine are nine and not one account**, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature on the space, both of Ash's subtractions riding locked and unread up the clay road in Berr's box with the key gone up in a coat pocket and not coming back down, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine standing out of nine and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the holding of Ash 26, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction or the boy's gaps; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; nine record-first hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; the burned slate at five with the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings and the row at five askings; the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping is invented to make a row come out even (T015/T041/T047 advanced and not paid; T061/T082; T078; T080; T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). Count closes at **359 exact**, six months and one hundred and seventy-nine days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid 359 days with its payer unnamed and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092). The hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — answer **294**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. **Two hundred and ninety-four honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and not one stands up and calls itself a doctrine.** Ash goes out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the month carries both names the way a pot carries two handles and is none the worse. Stone comes on in the dark beyond the door and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; the first firing of Stone stands far off and unbrought, the boy's first birthday on Stone 7 (Day 366) stands beyond that and the Hearth Drawing on Stone 12 (Day 371) further still. Nothing was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended. Forward, not closed.
